_om: Nissen in English (The Almond, rusj.no/en/the-almond/) – the almond in the Christmas porridge as a bluffing game. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The UK has no almond tradition, so the texts explain it lightly and speak of porridge and the elf. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to look
Mandelen i grøten som bløffespill. Én av: In the Nordic countries one almond is hidden in the Christmas porridge, and whoever finds it wins a marzipan pig. Here it's a bluffing game: one of you secretly gets the almond – and has to act normal while the elf asks questions.
Mobilen går rundt. Hold fingeren på grøt: Pass the phone round. Hold your finger on the porridge bowl and secretly check whether you got the almond. Only one person gets it.
Den som har mandelen, kan godt peke på n: Whoever has the almond is allowed to point at someone else.
Alle må svare på spørsmålene – også den: Everyone has to answer the elf's questions – including whoever has the almond.
Someone has the almond in their porridge.
Klarer hen å late som ingenting?: Can they keep a straight face?
Mobilen går rundt i samme rekkefølge som: The phone goes round in the same order as the list.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se om du f: Hold your finger on the card to see if you got the almond
Spill en runde, så blir det kåring!: Play a round and there'll be results!
Ingen slapp unna med mandelen i kveld. F: Nobody got away with the almond tonight. What a bunch of detectives!
Angret – poengene er tatt bort: Undone – the points have been taken back
You can always start a new one.
You'll go straight to the results.
Alle snur seg samtidig og later som de p: Everyone turns away at the same time and pretends to pop an almond in their mouth. Only the one who got the almond really does – the others hide theirs in their hand.
Nissen stiller spørsmål til én og én. Sv: The elf asks one player at a time. Answer as best you can – with the almond in your mouth – and try to look innocent.
Når alle snur seg: putt mandelen ekte i: When everyone turns away: pop the almond in your mouth for real. Don't give anything away!
Når alle snur seg: bare lat som du putte: When everyone turns away: just pretend to pop the almond in your mouth.
Alle snur ryggen til bordet og later som: Everyone turns their back to the table and pretends to pop the almond in their mouth. Only the one who got the almond does it for real.
Alle har snudd seg – til nissen: Everyone is back – over to the elf
Dere trenger én hel mandel per spiller –: You need one whole almond per player – or something just as big, like a piece of chocolate.
Alle trenger en hel mandel. Nøtteallergi: Everyone needs a whole almond. Nut allergy at the table? Use something nut-free that's just as big, like a piece of chocolate.
Små barn med? Bruk heller en liten sjoko: Playing with small children? Use a small piece of chocolate instead of a whole almond, and make sure nobody runs about or messes around with something in their mouth.
{poeng} til {navn}, og 1 poeng til hver: {poeng} to {navn}, and 1 point to everyone who pointed right.
1 point to everyone who pointed right.
Alle peker på én – også den som har mand: Everyone points at one person – the almond holder too.
Den som hadde mandelen, gaper opp og vis: Whoever had the almond opens wide and shows it. Pointed right? 1 point. The almond holder gets 1 point for everyone they fooled – and the marzipan pig if they fooled the lot.
Gap opp og vis mandelen, {navn}!: Open wide and show the almond, {navn}!
Ikke svelg mandelen! Gjem den i munnen t: Don't swallow the almond! Hide it in your mouth until it's time to open wide.
Snu dere tilbake og se uskyldige ut. Ing: Turn back round and look innocent. Nobody says a word!
Tell ned, og alle peker samtidig på den: Count down, and everyone points at once at who they think has the almond. Keep pointing!
Pek på den du tror har mandelen – her på: Point at whoever you think has the almond – here on your phone. Whoever has the almond points too.
